conclusion: In this JVM, supplying jdk.net.hosts.file replaced normal DNS resolution for names not present in the custom file. The workaround is suitable only if SonarScanner needs no additional DNS-only hostname during analysis.
limitations: Observed on the local OpenJDK 25 runtime, not yet on the pinned SonarScanner image running Java 17.
The example.com lookup is a point-in-time resolver check and does not guarantee all network behavior.
This is a local JVM behavior receipt, not a GitLab runner or Sonar analysis result.
